description: Arri RPC message fixtures. See /specifications/arri_rpc.md and the README.md in this directory.

valid.name: Invocation
valid.description: INVOCATION with every reserved header, custom headers, and a body

valid.name: Invocation_Minimal
valid.description: INVOCATION with only an rpc name

valid.name: Invocation_NoBody
valid.description: INVOCATION for a procedure with a streamed input (the body is omitted)

valid.name: Invocation_LastMsgId
valid.description: INVOCATION resuming an output stream

valid.name: Invocation_SpecialHeaderValues
valid.description: header values containing tabs, colons, and other printable ASCII

valid.name: Ok
valid.description: OK with custom headers and a body

valid.name: Ok_NoBody
valid.description: OK for a procedure without a response

valid.name: Error
valid.description: ERROR with a typed error body

valid.name: Error_ConnectionLevel
valid.description: ERROR without a req-id (connection-level error)

message.body: {"code":"PROTOCOL_ERROR","message":"Invalid message. Missing empty line after headers."}

valid.name: StreamStart
valid.description: STREAM_START with a content type and custom headers

valid.name: StreamData
valid.description: STREAM_DATA with a msg-id

valid.name: StreamData_BodyWithEmptyLines
valid.description:
STREAM_DATA whose body contains "

" (only the first "

" ends the head)

valid.name: StreamData_BinaryBody
valid.description:
STREAM_DATA whose body is arbitrary bytes (null bytes, invalid UTF-8, "

", "
")

valid.name: StreamEnd
valid.description: STREAM_END with a reason

valid.name: StreamEnd_NoReason
valid.description: STREAM_END with only a req-id

valid.name: Cancel
valid.description: CANCEL with a reason

valid.name: ConnectionStart
valid.description: CONNECTION_START with a heartbeat interval

valid.name: Heartbeat
valid.description: HEARTBEAT with a heartbeat interval

valid.name: Heartbeat_NoInterval
valid.description: HEARTBEAT without any headers

valid.name: GoAway
valid.description: GOAWAY with a reason

valid.name: Invocation_MixedCaseHeaders
valid.description: header keys are case-insensitive and normalized to lowercase

valid.name: Invocation_UntrimmedHeaderValues
valid.description: leading/trailing spaces and tabs are trimmed from header values, and the space after ":" is optional

valid.name: Invocation_HeaderOrder
valid.description: reserved and custom headers may appear in any order

valid.name: Invocation_BindingHeaders
valid.description: headers starting with "arri-" are ignored

valid.name: StreamEnd_IgnoredHeaders
valid.description: reserved headers that do not apply to the message type, and custom headers on message types without custom headers, are ignored

invalid.name: Empty
invalid.description: empty input

invalid.name: MissingHeadEnd
invalid.description: no empty line after the headers

invalid.name: CrlfLineEndings
invalid.description: "\r\n" line endings are not supported

invalid.name: NonAsciiHeaderValue
invalid.description: header values must be ASCII

invalid.name: ControlCharacterInHead
invalid.description: the head may not contain control characters other than tab and line feed

invalid.name: WrongPrefix
invalid.description: first line does not start with "ARRIRPC/"

invalid.name: UnsupportedVersion
invalid.description: unsupported protocol version

invalid.name: LowercaseMessageType
invalid.description: message types are case-sensitive

invalid.name: UnknownMessageType
invalid.description: unknown message type

invalid.name: MissingMessageType
invalid.description: first line has no message type

invalid.name: EmptyFirstLine
invalid.description: message starts with an empty line

invalid.name: Invocation_MissingRpcName
invalid.description: INVOCATION without an rpc name

invalid.name: Invocation_ExtraTokens
invalid.description: INVOCATION with more than one rpc name

invalid.name: Ok_ExtraTokens
invalid.description: only INVOCATION may have content after the message type

invalid.name: DuplicateHeader
invalid.description: header keys may only appear once (case-insensitive)

invalid.name: HeaderMissingColon
invalid.description: header line without a ":"

invalid.name: HeaderEmptyKey
invalid.description: header line with an empty key

invalid.name: HeaderInvalidKey
invalid.description: header keys must be HTTP token characters

invalid.name: ReqIdWithSpace
invalid.description: req-id must be visible ASCII (no spaces)

invalid.name: ReqIdEmpty
invalid.description: req-id must not be empty

invalid.name: ReqIdTooLong
invalid.description: req-id must be at most 128 characters

invalid.name: HeartbeatIntervalNotANumber
invalid.description: heartbeat-interval must be a non-negative integer

invalid.name: HeartbeatIntervalNegative
invalid.description: heartbeat-interval must be a non-negative integer

invalid.name: HeartbeatIntervalDecimal
invalid.description: heartbeat-interval must be a non-negative integer
